end.lastMia: Thanks so much, your code is on your screen now. Enjoy the globe!

entries.text: Hi, it's Mia from Replogle Globes. This takes about three minutes, and your code shows on this screen as soon as we finish. Who's the globe for?
It's for my son, he turns twelve next month and he is really into maps and geography at school.
Lovely. What made you look at globes today?
He has been asking for a lit globe for his desk, something he can use for homework and that looks nice at night.
What matters most in the one you pick?
Accurate and up to date borders, a size that fits a small desk, and a light that is not too bright for his room.
What else are you comparing it with?
I saw a cheaper one on Amazon but the reviews said the colours were faded, so I came back here to compare.
What would make you buy today?
Knowing it ships before his birthday and that the twelve inch one is back in stock or what the closest one is.
